Q35. H/o relative as HNPCC. what to do for screening (lynch syndrome) -  
  
colonoscopy - every 1-2 y , from 25 (or 5y younger than 1st gen affected relative or 10y younger if distant) - since hnpcc is autosomal dominant , inc lifetime risk to colorectal cancer IF WOMEN ENDOMETRIAL AND OVARIAN Cancer risk is high  
  
PLEASE REFER - [https://www.eviq.org.au/cancer-genetics/adult/risk-management/1410-mmr-genes-lynch-syndrome-risk-management#cancer-tumour-risk-management-guidelines](https://www.eviq.org.au/cancer-genetics/adult/risk-management/1410-mmr-genes-lynch-syndrome-risk-management#cancer-tumour-risk-management-guidelines)
